# Palette fixtures

Files written by other tools, used as ground truth for `gimp_import_palette` (#81). Unchanged copies.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `arne-v20-16.aco`, `arne-v20-16.act`, `arne-v20-16.pal`, `Material_Palette.aco`, `palette_simple.ase`, `ADG3-CMYK.ase` | [ColorPaletteCodable](https://github.com/dagronf/ColorPaletteCodable/tree/c822de9c6c199ca3740f65e7c8824d66ce6d64ee/Tests/ColorPaletteCodableTests/resources/palette) test resources (`Material Palette.aco` renamed with an underscore) | MIT |
| `arne16.gpl`, `pico-8.gpl`, `pico-8.ase`, `pico-8.pal` | Exports of the [Arne 16](https://lospec.com/palette-list/arne-16) and [PICO-8](https://lospec.com/palette-list/pico-8) palettes by Lospec's palette list, downloaded 2026-11-08 | color lists (facts); the palettes are by Arne Niklas Jansson and Lexaloffle |
